name: localis-workspace
description: Localis — a private, local-first AI workspace for developers.
author: KebiLab

scripts.build: npm run build -w @localis/core && npm run build -w @localis/cli && npm run build -w @localis/web && npm run build -w @localis/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @localis/core && npm run test -w @localis/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @localis/core && npm run build -w @localis/core && npm run typecheck -w @localis/cli && npm run typecheck -w @localis/web && npm run typecheck -w @localis/desktop
